t: Heat alarm detects rapid rises in temperature to alert of potential fire risks with a loud alarm. Features enhanced sensing technology to reduce false alarms and end-of-life notification to replace battery. Ideal for smoky, dusty, or humid areas that may trigger false smoke alarms. Easy to install with included twist-and-click mounting bracket.
b: Ideal for Smoky, Dusty, or Humid Areas That May Trigger False Alarms
Suitable for Kitchen, Garage or Attic
